objective: Test whether the surviving capacity-aware REL_INC-ZOE collisions are repaired by retaining the unordered multiset of per-column remaining capacities, without attaching capacities to specific REL_INC column roles.
motivation: EW-RS-052 shows exact total remaining capacity plus REL_INC is Q-V inexact on 4x4-k4 and 4x5-k4.
The first surviving collisions preserve REL_INC, width, and total capacity while changing local height/capacity profiles such as [1,3] versus [2,2] and [1,4] versus [2,3].
Foundational IA round 48 requires testing the unordered per-column capacity profile before preserving capacity-to-incidence role alignment.

frozenCountState.name: ZOE
frozenCountState.definition: For each retained structural identity: omit zero total count, emit O for positive odd total multiplicity, and E for positive even total multiplicity.

candidate.name: CAP_PROFILE_REL_INC_ZOE
candidate.definition: Map each exact component to (REL_INC, component width, sorted multiset of remaining local column capacities H-h_c); sum multiplicities over equal descriptors; apply ZOE.
candidate.alignment: Per-column capacities are sorted independently and are not attached to REL_INC column roles.

antiCircularity: The capacity-profile coordinate is fixed before qualification.
Per-column remaining capacities are computed only from board height and current local frontier heights.
The unordered profile was selected by the pre-existing foundational IA rule before this qualification.
No W/D/L label selects a column role, profile entry, merge, phase grade, or coefficient.
falsifiers: Any mixed scalar-value EXACT_ZOE class invalidates the established control.
Any mixed scalar-value CAP_PROFILE_REL_INC_ZOE class rejects the unaligned capacity-profile descriptor on that carrier.
nextIfCommonSuccess: Freeze CAP_PROFILE_REL_INC_ZOE as the current structural identity compression and qualify it unchanged on predeclared fresh non-affine 5x4-k4 before decoder discovery.
nextIfFail: Freeze the minimum collision families and test role-aligned column capacity labels inside REL_INC; do not restore arbitrary exact component identity.
interpretationGuards: Passing establishes bounded Q-V sufficiency only, not Q-A/Q-F.
A pass does not prove the unordered capacity profile minimal.
A failure localizes the next distinction to capacity-to-incidence alignment or another exact component feature still erased.
No standard-7x6 or universal theorem follows.
